name: How long does a typical flooring replacement project take?
description: Project duration varies, from 1-3 days for a single room to 3-7+ days for a whole home, depending on project scope and materials.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical flooring replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flooring replacement project depends on several factors, including the size of the area, the type of flooring material chosen, and the extent of subfloor preparation required. For a single room, a project might take 1-3 days. For an entire home, it could range from 3-7 days or more. We'll provide a clear timeline estimate after assessing your specific project details.
